# InputNoisePerturbationRobustness

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The property of a neural network to maintain accurate output predictions when its input signals are corrupted by random noise perturbations. Critical for iNEST systems where neuromorphic hardware may introduce stochastic noise in sensory inputs, affecting reliability of in-network inference.
